newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico to slap tariff on Taiwan ball bearings.
newsitem.headline: Mexico to slap tariff on Taiwan ball bearings.

text.p: Mexico will slap Taiwan with a provisional 50.7 percent tariff on imports of steel ball bearings for bicycles, the Trade Ministry (SECOFI) said on Monday.
A resolution on the trade dispute will appear in the Official Diary on Tuesday, the minstry said in a communique.

"SECOFI determined that during the period investigated imports of this product entered the Mexican market in conditions of discriminatory prices (dumping), which led to a considerable increase in their sales and caused damage to the national industry that produces this type of ball bearing," the communique said.
The provisional tariff would apply to Taiwanese-made steel ball bearings regardless of whether they are passed through a third country, the statement said.
But it said perforated ball bearings plated with nickel-chrome would be exempt from the tariff.
The Trade Ministry said it would allow affected companies to present their views on the matter while an investigation continues.
